svg.title: A $60,000 Launch Budget Inside the Canonical Range
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-startup-capital-allocation; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: A $60,000 Launch Budget Inside the Canonical Range; subtitle: Four distinct buckets within the $15,000–$100,000 USD startup envelope.; chapter number: 4; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Numeric values are USD capital allocations totaling $60,000; they are not four expense deductions from the annual scorecard. The startup range is $15,000–$100,000, monthly operating expense range is $3,000–$18,000, and first-deal timing is 3–12 months. Cash reserved for runway is not itself an expense.; caption: $12,000 + $8,000 + $15,000 + $25,000 = $60,000. The $25,000 runway bucket covers about 8.3 months at $3,000 monthly, but only 1.8 months at the modeled $14,000 Base recurring burn. Do not deploy Base spending before the cash plan can support delayed closings.; stages: label: Authority and engagement setup; value: $12,000 establishes the scoped operating and contracting structure.; numeric value: 12000.0; detail: Fund jurisdiction-specific license analysis, required applications, engagement drafting, agency disclosures, insurance setup, and escrow-provider onboarding. Confirm actual requirements before allocating money to promotion for a service the operator cannot yet perform.; label: Data room and operating systems; value: $8,000 establishes secure records and repeatable transaction workflows.; numeric value: 8000.0; detail: Configure HubSpot, Airtable, SharePoint, access controls, backup procedures, templates, and electronic signatures. Separate initial setup from recurring subscriptions; each paid invoice belongs once in the cash ledger and receives appropriate accounting treatment.; label: Sector research and mandate acquisition; value: $15,000 funds a bounded specialist-market acquisition program.; numeric value: 15000.0; detail: Purchase targeted sector data, conduct owner research, prepare evidence-led outreach, and attend selected industry meetings. Release spend in measured batches based on qualified discussions and signed mandates rather than raw contact counts.; label: Uncommitted operating runway; value: $25,000 remains available for lean operations and closing delays.; numeric value: 25000.0; detail: Keep this bucket liquid and separate from client funds. Twelve months at the $3,000 monthly floor requires $36,000 before additional deal costs; this allocation therefore requires lower deployment, added capital, or an explicit pause plan for a prolonged delay.

rect.title: label: Authority and engagement setup; numeric value: 12000.0; value: $12,000 establishes the scoped operating and contracting structure.; detail: Fund jurisdiction-specific license analysis, required applications, engagement drafting, agency disclosures, insurance setup, and escrow-provider onboarding. Confirm actual requirements before allocating money to promotion for a service the operator cannot yet perform.

text.tspan: Authority and engagement setup: $12,000 establishes the scoped operating and contracting structure.

rect.title: label: Data room and operating systems; numeric value: 8000.0; value: $8,000 establishes secure records and repeatable transaction workflows.; detail: Configure HubSpot, Airtable, SharePoint, access controls, backup procedures, templates, and electronic signatures. Separate initial setup from recurring subscriptions; each paid invoice belongs once in the cash ledger and receives appropriate accounting treatment.

Release spend in measured batches based on qualified discussions and signed mandates rather than raw contact counts.

text.title: Assumptions: Numeric values are USD capital allocations totaling $60,000; they are not four expense deductions from the annual scorecard. The startup range is $15,000–$100,000, monthly operating expense range is $3,000–$18,000, and first-deal timing is 3–12 months. Cash reserved for runway is not itself an expense.
